run_simsiam_training: run SimSiam self-supervised training on ImageNet with distributed multi-GPU support
create_simsiam_model: create a SimSiam model with a base encoder, feature dimension, and predictor hidden dimension
build_two_crops_transform: build a TwoCropsTransform that applies the same base transform to produce two random crops of an image
apply_gaussian_blur_augmentation: apply GaussianBlur image augmentation with configurable sigma range to random crops
adjust_learning_rate_schedule: adjust the learning rate using a cosine decay schedule with optional fixed predictor learning rate
